entry.summary:
Vendor: Elite Cue
Type:

Ultimate Grip. Maximum Control. Minimal Residue.

The TAOM V10 Professional Chalk is a premium billiard chalk handmade in Finland and engineered for players who demand exceptional cue-ball grip without sacrificing a clean playing experience.

Its latest-generation formula provides strong friction between the cue tip and cue ball, giving players the confidence to apply English, draw, follow, and other demanding shots while maintaining a smooth and controlled feel.

Designed to work with all cue-tip hardnesses, from soft to hard, V10 offers consistent performance across different playing styles and cuesports.

Why Choose TAOM V10?

  • Ultimate Grip — Provides exceptional tip-to-ball friction for confident cue-ball control
  • Maximum Spin Potential — Helps maintain grip when applying English and demanding spin
  • Minimal Residue — Designed for a remarkably clean playing experience
  • Consistent Contact — Helps provide reliable tip-to-ball connection shot after shot
  • Excellent Control — Combines strong grip with a controlled and flexible playing feel
  • All Tip Hardness Compatible — Suitable for soft, medium, and hard tips
  • Multi-Cuesport Performance — Suitable for pool, snooker, and other cuesports
  • Handmade in Finland — Produced using Taom's specialized chalk formulation

The V10 Advantage

More grip when you need it.
Less residue where you don't.

TAOM V10 is engineered to give players the friction needed for demanding shots while keeping unwanted chalk transfer to a minimum. This means a cleaner cue ball, cleaner shaft, and cleaner playing surface.

Perfect for: Players who want maximum cue-tip grip, reliable spin, precise cue-ball control, and a cleaner playing experience without compromising performance.

TAOM V10 — Ultimate Grip. Clean Performance.

entry.title: KAMUI ROKU Premium Chalk
entry.summary:
Vendor: Elite Cue
Type:
Price: 2100.00

Maximum Grip. Precise Control. Expanded Sweet Spot.

The KAMUI ROKU is a premium Japanese billiard chalk engineered for players who demand exceptional grip, reliable adhesion, and precise cue-ball control. Its ultra-fine particle formulation is designed to maximize friction between the cue tip and cue ball, giving players greater confidence and consistency when applying English and demanding spin.

The name “ROKU,” meaning “six” in Japanese, reflects its distinctive hexagonal shape and the hexagonal close-packing concept behind its development. This unique approach brings together performance-focused engineering and distinctive design in a chalk developed for serious players.

Why Choose KAMUI ROKU?

  • High Grip Power — Provides strong friction between the cue tip and cue ball
  • Excellent Adhesion — Fine particles adhere effectively to the tip for reliable coverage
  • Ultra-Fine Particles — Designed to promote strong grip and an expanded effective contact area
  • Expanded Sweet Spot — Helps maintain control when striking the cue ball with English
  • High Solidity — Dense construction helps provide consistent application and durability
  • Greater Spin Control — Strong tip-to-ball friction supports demanding English, draw, and follow shots
  • Reduced Chalk Transfer — Designed to minimize unwanted residue on the cue ball and cloth
  • Japanese Precision — Developed in Japan with a performance-focused particle structure

The ROKU Advantage

Grip gives you the confidence to attack the cue ball.

Adhesion helps keep the tip properly covered without excessive application.

Solidity provides a dense, consistent chalk designed for easy application and lasting performance.

Together, these characteristics create a balanced combination of grip, control, consistency, and durability.

Unique Hexagonal Design

ROKU's distinctive six-sided shape is more than a visual signature. Its name and design are connected to KAMUI's hexagonal close-packing concept, reflecting the development philosophy behind its ultra-fine particle structure.

Available in Blue, Forest, Slate, and Sakura, ROKU combines distinctive design with high-level performance for players who demand more from their equipment.

Perfect For

Players looking for a premium billiard chalk that delivers exceptional grip, strong adhesion, increased spin potential, precise cue-ball control, and reduced chalk transfer.

KAMUI ROKU — Maximum Grip. Precise Control. 🎱

entry.title: SUPER HybRid CHALK
entry.summary:
Vendor: Elite Cue
Type:
Price: 1300.00

Enhanced Grip. Wider Contact. Cleaner Play.

The SUPER HybRid CHALK is an advanced Japanese billiard chalk developed in collaboration with professional players Lo Li-Wen and Satoshi Kawabata. Evolved from the original HybRid CHALK, its formula was completely reconsidered and refined to deliver enhanced grip, improved miscue resistance, and a more balanced chalking experience.

The refined formulation provides a slightly more moist and comfortable feel compared with traditional dry chalk while maintaining controlled application. This balanced character gives players greater confidence when approaching demanding contact points, including shots played close to the edge or lower areas of the cue ball.

Why Choose SUPER HybRid?

  • Enhanced Grip — Provides strong tip-to-ball friction for confident cue-ball control
  • Wider Effective Contact — Helps maintain grip when striking closer to the edge of the cue ball
  • Excellent Miscue Resistance — Designed to provide greater confidence on demanding contact points
  • Balanced Chalking Feel — Sits between traditional dry chalk and very moist formulas
  • Smooth Application — Provides a comfortable and controlled feel when applying chalk to the tip
  • Low Chalk Transfer — Designed to minimize unwanted marks on the cue ball, cloth, and hand
  • Longer Lasting — Developed to wear more slowly than the original HybRid CHALK
  • Professional Development — Developed together with professional players Lo Li-Wen and Satoshi Kawabata
  • Made in Japan — Premium Japanese billiard chalk

The SUPER HybRid Advantage

More Grip gives you greater confidence when pushing the limits of cue-ball control.

Wider Contact helps maintain reliable tip-to-ball friction when playing extreme English or contacting lower and outer areas of the cue ball.

Balanced Moisture provides a comfortable chalking feel without becoming excessively sticky or dry.

Low Transfer helps keep the cue ball, cloth, and playing hand cleaner during play.

Available Colors

Blue • Green • Purple

Perfect For

Players looking for a premium Japanese billiard chalk that combines enhanced grip, excellent miscue resistance, a balanced chalking feel, low transfer, and long-lasting performance.

SUPER HybRid CHALK — Enhanced Grip. Wider Contact. Cleaner Play. 🎱

  • Helps reduce miscues and improve shot consistency
